Not my first Comfee’, but so far the best - We had a smaller Comfee’ washing machine (.9 cub.ft) that worked great for 2 years. Then the little guy sprung a leak, it was out of warranty, and we decided to donate it and buy a bigger machine. This one IS bigger, fits a lot more. I have done about 6 loads so far, and if things change I will update the review. This time I bought an extended warranty for it, so it will be going back if something goes wrong.

It is louder than my last one, you can hear the motor rev up when it does the spin cycles. In general this is better, it revs up…in increments, helping the load to balance in the bin before hitting top speed. Love this, versus my old machine that I would refill (a waste water) when it was out of balance to re-distribute the clothes. It does mean the motor can get a little loud when it does this, but not so much that you worry about neighbors hearing it or can’t have a phone conversation in front of it. Just enough for me to notice it was more than my last .9 cubic ft machine.

One other thing, if you set it for 1 spin cycle - that doesn’t seem to include a full rinse (I expect it to fill the bin, move clothes around in fresh water, extract water and then spin). It seems to trickle water over the clothes as the bin moves around a few times and then it spins at high speed to do the final cycle. Sort of confusing, and I am still learning to see if there is another pre-set program that works differently, but I find choosing (2) spin cycles solves this issue. I expect a rinse cycle to do more, I guess!

Otherwise it’s pretty good. I can do larger loads, with room so the clothes can move around and get clean. Will update if anything changes as I keep the machine longer.
